name: Data Fixtures
description: Generates dummy content via developer-defined, service-tagged fixture generators, driven by Drush.
project_description: Data Fixtures is a developer tool for populating a Drupal site with dummy content for local development and test environments. It defines no content of its own: instead, other modules register PHP "generator" classes (services tagged `data_fixtures`, each implementing `Drupal\data_fixtures\Interfaces\Generator` with `load()` and `unLoad()` methods) that create and later remove sample entities, menu items, media, users and other structures. A `FixturesManager` service collects all tagged generators, sorts them by priority, and Drush commands (`fixtures:list`, `fixtures:load`, `fixtures:unload`, `fixtures:reload`) run them in order (or in reverse on unload). An optional `AbstractGenerator` base class wraps fakerphp/faker and offers helpers for links, formatted text, random entity lookup, media-by-filename lookup, and bulk entity deletion. The module ships no routes, permissions, or config; it is explicitly intended for local development and building disposable test/CI environments, never production.
